title: tephroseris crispa
intro: Tephroseris crispa, commonly known as the Alpine Saw-wort or Alpine Tephroseris, is a species of flowering plant in the daisy family. It is a perennial plant that has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve wound healing. The health benefits of Tephroseris crispa include its potential to reduce fever, improve digestion, and support the immune system, making it a valuable medicinal plant in traditional folk medicine.
